title: Grief
organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention / How Right Now
usable_for: anchors grief as a response to loss and common emotion/sleep/appetite/energy changes without diagnostic overreach
do_not_use_for: jurisdiction-free legal, funeral, estate, financial, tax, clinical, mental-health, or ritual advice
complete checklists for an individual reader
diagnosing grief, prescribing grief duration, or replacing crisis support
publishing identifiable family, child, object, relationship, or funeral details without consent and review
settling contested family, next-of-kin, funeral, or property decisions
extraction_rules: extract vocabulary, scene context, and review gates, not instructions
preserve jurisdiction, institution, culture, relationship, age, and authority boundaries
cite source_id in every dependent record
route legal, financial, funeral, clinical, mental-health, crisis, child, and ritual decisions to qualified local support
do not turn public practical lists into universal reader commands
